items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: He was around there. All these people were downtown.

ctx.x: I think he was a Johnson or Lincoln. Which was it? I forget. I don't know. He was a Lincoln. I don't know. I don't think he made too much success. I think Buddy Bowden shut him down. Yeah. But, uh, who was that? Bunk Johnson. Have you heard of him? Bunk Johnson. Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh. Oh.

Oh. He was around there. All these people were downtown. Down there. Down there big clubs and things. All the big dance halls downtown. All these boys were downtown. He lived once over the river where he was at. And St. Charles?
